description: Adds a transposition in semitones to each of eight polyphonic channels, applied only while that channel's gate is high

params.text: Sets what that channel is transposed by while its gate is high, stepping from -12 to +12 semitones and added as that many twelfths of a volt
Holds all eight gates high so every transposition is applied at once and the gate jacks are ignored; it does that in the position the maker's tooltip calls Off

inputs.text: A gate for one channel: above 0V that channel's transposition is applied. A cable here takes that channel over from the GATES jack.
Carries a gate for each channel that has no cable in its own jack, one per polyphonic channel; channels past the end of this cable follow its last channel
The voltages to transpose, one per polyphonic channel; channels past the end of the cable repeat its last channel

outputs.text: The eight transposed voltages, always as an eight-channel polyphonic cable

notes: the output always carries eight channels, whatever the input cable holds; channels the input does not reach repeat its last one.
with nothing patched into IN every channel starts from 0V, so the output is each gated channel's transposition on its own.
the lamp beside a gate jack lights while that channel's gate is high, whether the gate came from that jack, from GATES, or from the all-on switch.
a gate counts as high above 0V, so any positive voltage opens it.
